category_title: Students who exhibit frustration-based crying and self-abusive behavior during long tasks
scenario_title: Reading worksheets presented in a stapled packet
minimal_context: Shaun is sitting in the classroom and is presented with a stapled packet of reading worksheets to complete.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Shaun, here is your stapled packet of reading worksheets. Please start working on them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the stapled packet of worksheets and engages in off-task behavior, making a low grunting noise.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to focus on your reading. Just do your best.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts whining and making uninterpretable, garbled vocalizations instead of looking at the worksheets.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying. Let me know if you have a question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Begins crying and engaging in self-abusive behavior, showing he is easily frustrated by the long packet of worksheets.)
